    Changelog

    This document records the major changes to FMOD Plus.

    [1.7.2] - 2026-08-11

    Changed

    • Moved the About window to the Bootstrap Editor assembly so it can be used regardless of whether FMOD is installed.
    • Changed the About window's UXML, USS, logo, and package.json resolution to use GUIDs and AssetDatabase.GUIDToAssetPath instead of fixed paths or serialized references.
    • Refined the About UI structure and styles, and added a diagnosable fallback message when loading the package version fails.

    Fixed

    • Fixed the About window content not rendering when a serialized UXML or package.json reference was not assigned.

    [1.7.1] - 2026-08-11

    Changed

    • Organized the fields, properties, public methods, and private helpers in KeyReference by responsibility.
    • Expanded the XML documentation for KeyReference.Key, Guid, Path, ToString(), and the Key lookup APIs.
    • Organized the fields, overrides, private helpers, and internal enum in FMODEventTrigger by responsibility.

    [1.7.0] - 2026-08-11

    Added

    • Added APIs to KeyReference for safely retrieving Events and initial parameters from Global and Local Key Lists.
    • Added EditMode tests for default Key creation, duplicate prevention, immediate lookup after modification, and null-data handling in AudioPathByString.
    • Added EditMode tests that verify the Unity-version-appropriate static field initialization policy.

    Changed

    • Separated playback, command, and event-handling responsibilities in FMODAudioSource, CommandSender, and FMODEventTrigger, and revised their public API documentation.
    • Changed LocalKeyList to encapsulate serialized fields and provide value-oriented lookup APIs (Count, TryGetEvent, TryGetParameters, and TryGetEventAndParameters).
    • Changed Command Sender and Editor UI code that references Local Key Lists to use LocalKeyList lookup APIs instead of directly iterating serialized arrays.
    • Removed duplicated FMOD EventReference.Find code from KeyReference and clarified the responsibilities and null handling of the Key List reference model.
    • Split AudioType, EventRefCallback, KeyAndPath, EventReferenceByKey, and AudioPathByString from FMODPlusUtility.cs into files organized by responsibility.
    • Changed FMODPlusUtility.Length to safely handle empty Events, invalid Event Descriptions, and lookup failures.
    • Expanded the public API XML documentation for AudioPathByString, EventRefAtKey, and KeyAndPath.
    • Applied [AutoStaticsCleanup] to mutable static fields on Unity 6.5 or newer, while retaining Enter Play Mode initialization callbacks on Unity 6.4 or older.
    • Replaced the legacy UXML factory/traits implementation in SimpleBaseField with the Unity 6 [UxmlElement] and [UxmlAttribute] APIs.
    • Expanded the public API XML documentation for Key List ScriptableObjects and Local Key List, and improved null safety.

    Fixed

    • Fixed exceptions or unnecessary error logs that could occur with null Local Key List collections, entries, parameter arrays, or empty Key lookups.
    • Fixed AudioPathByString returning stale Events or parameters from its internal Dictionary cache after its public list was modified.
    • Fixed default Keys being unavailable when an intermediate number was unused, and Keys with matching substrings being treated as duplicates.
    • Fixed EventRefCallback.TryGetClip throwing an exception for an invalid ClipStyle.
    • Fixed Global Key List singletons and Editor UI caches retaining previous state when re-entering Play Mode with Domain Reload disabled.
    • Fixed alignment callbacks being registered more than once when a custom UI field was reattached to a panel.

    Removed

    • Removed the legacy Event, AllowNonRigidbodyDoppler, UpdateActiveAudioSource(), and writable EventInstance APIs from FMODAudioSource.
    • Removed the legacy public ClipList field, top-level EventRefList, conversion ContextMenu, and old TryFind*/TryGetValue APIs from LocalKeyList.

    [1.7.0-beta.1] - 2026-08-11

    Added

    • Added the UI Toolkit-based FMOD/FMOD Plus/Setup window.
    • Added automatic Korean/English localization of the Setup window based on the system language.
    • Added detection of FMOD Integration under Assets and migration to Embedded UPM.
    • Added UPM SemVer conversion for FMOD Integration versions and automatic recovery of the FMOD.meta GUID.
    • Added migration preflight checks, file-move rollback, and Settings/Cache preservation.
    • Added a Global Key List Editor Window that combines AMB, BGM, and SFX.
    • Added Key-name search to Global and Local Key Lists.
    • Added a detail panel for editing the selected Event and initial parameters.
    • Added automatic application of the FMOD Studio Listener icon.

    Changed

    • Changed FMOD Plus to the com.nkstudio.fmodplus Embedded UPM package structure.
    • Changed FMOD package detection to use an asmdef Version Define for com.firelight.fmod-for-unity versions in [2.2.0,3.0.0).
    • Changed Runtime and Editor assemblies to compile only when FMOD is installed.
    • Rebuilt the Global and Local Key List editing UI with UXML/USS-based UI Toolkit.
    • Changed LocalKeyList to directly inherit MonoBehaviour, and the AMB/BGM/SFX lists to directly inherit ScriptableObject.
    • Changed FMODAudioSource to update distance-based playback state directly without an FMOD source hook.
    • Added minimum/maximum sizes and narrow-width responsive layout to the Setup window.

    Fixed

    • Fixed the selected Key List index becoming incorrect after searching or Undo/Redo.
    • Fixed fields and buttons being pushed sideways when the Local Key List Inspector was narrow.
    • Fixed initial parameter lists sometimes failing to refresh after changing an Event.
    • Fixed the FMOD migration button remaining disabled because AssetDatabase remembered a deleted package path.
    • Prevented path errors caused by including FMOD Settings and Cache in Packages.
    • Improved rollback ordering so an original meta file or package.json is not left behind when a file write fails during migration.

    Removed

    • Removed separate Global Key List menus for AMB, BGM, and SFX.
    • Removed the decorative dedicated Inspector UI from Global Key List ScriptableObjects.
    • Removed automatic registration of the legacy USE_FMOD and FMODPlus Scripting Defines.
    • Removed hooks that directly modified FMOD RuntimeManager and StudioListener Editor sources.
